notes.title: Janitor Salesman and Joystick Controls
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kG3tBRff9oE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Updates:

Added: Janitor Salesman in Arcade Mode
Updated: Joystick Controls.


JoyStick Controls
I have tested Dave-Man extensively with a game pad, but it was a retro SNES-style gamepad.  Therefore no joystick.  Upon purchasing another controller with joysticks I realized the setup wasn't optimal.

With the update there is now more "dead zone" to prevent accidentally taking a turn.

I hope that helps but if anyone has any further feedback or specific issues I'd be happy to revise.  I wanted to get this updated ASAP as though I'm not sure it is perfect I am confident it is much better than before.

Janitor Salesman
This was supposed to be a fully functional feature at the initial release.  It was mostly setup but I just didn't have time to test it fully.  Now it is fully tested and good to go!

In Arcade Mode you can now talk to the janitor—after beating a level*—and you can trade your powerups:

Trade 2 powerups for one powerup of your choosing
Trade 3 powerups for an extra life


*When talking to the janitor at the beginning of Arcade mode he will explain Arcade Mode.  After beating a level he will become a salesman.

https://i.imgur.com/JVGcxhv.png

For either trade, you are trading the first powerups in your inventory.  To be clear, that means starting on the left of the UI.  I thought about letting the player choose which ones but decided against it.  It was a tad easier to implement this way but I also think it forces some strategy.

Trade for Powerups
Selecting this option will bring up a menu of every powerup you have unlocked.  Side-note, to make more powerups available in Arcade mode you must find them in Story Mode.

This trade is intended mostly for if you favor certain powerups over others.  So if you have two powerups you don't care for you can turn them in and nab one of your choosing.  On the flip side, if you love a powerup you can try to horde as many as you can of it by turning in others.

The new powerup goes at the end of your inventory; far right.  If it were to go at the beginning it would be wasteful to make another trade.

Trade for Lives
Straightforward - trade your next 3 powerups for an extra life.

There is a cap of 5 lives at time.

...really this is just to keep that UI looking pretty :)  But of course if you lose one you can just make the trade then. No rush.

Update actually went live 8/23/20. v1.0.35 was live for a short period on 8/23/20.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.34 Notes
notes.content:
This update was mainly behind the scenes. Restructured how data was stored to not only fix some issues with Achievements and such but also make the structure more future-proof if more is added.


Fixed bug with Millennials Achievement
Fixed bug with World Traveler (Globe) Achievement
Fixed Soda Can Powerup not being tracked as collected, for Arcade Mode availability
Record Player menu moved up to avoid going off screen when full
Fixed bug that sometimes would give powerups back to you in Arcade Mode
Fixed issue that prevented Ethel the Aardvark (the book added last update) from being marked as collected (for Achievement Purposes)

notes.title: V1.0.23 Release Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.23 Release notes

 Added: Quest Item Notifications Popup. There are “quest items” that go straight into your inventory. Most players are not aware of these items as the only way to see them is to pause the game and open your inventory.  Now a UI notification will appear to make it obvious.
 Added: WASD controls.  Now players can use controller/gamepad, keyboard arrow, or keyboard WASD for controls. Customizable controls are still intended down the road.
 Removed: Mute key (M).  Most players were not aware of the mute key, thus when pressing it on accident they weren’t sure what happened and how to get the sound back on.  Sound settings intended to be added down the road.
 Removed: Touch/Mouse controls.  These were never intended for this platform.
 Edited: Controls Explanation graphic.  Reached by pausing the game or visiting the computer in the basement of the title screen.
 Added: Version Number.  When pausing the game you will now see the version number (currently v1.0.23) in the bottom right corner.
 Added: new book. Ethel the Aardvark.
 Added: Two new levels. Floor 40 & 41.
 Added: The name “Taco” to the Suggested Cat names.  Cycle through name suggestions by choosing the ??? on the naming prompt.
 Other miscellaneous dialogue additions/edits, bug fixes, and minor changes/fixes/improvements.
 Added: Ability to pet the cat when laying on the window sill. Intending to add more cat interactions down the road.
